title: AI Music Style Recipes: 564 Styles with BPM and Settings
reported_observation: Repository advertises a CC0 dataset of 564 music styles, with style prompts and suggested BPM, Weirdness and Style Influence, in CSV/JSON/Parquet formats.
creator_interpretation: Potentially useful as a reference set for conventional prompt vocabulary and genre baselines, but the dataset's methodology and whether the settings were measured or curated need audit.
our_hypothesis: Compare its genre/style descriptors and numeric recommendations against the user's GENRELAB/GENECLECT corpus and independently test selected entries.
limitations: Metadata and excerpt summary from publicly accessible web results; inspect full source before promotion.
